children: The Singapore dollar weakens against its U.S. counterpart in Asia. Traders are focusing on a heavy slate of U.S. economic data, including the second estimate of 3Q GDP growth and PCE inflation data, UOB's Lee Sue Ann and Quek Ser Leang say in a note. These readings will offer fresh clues on U.S. growth outlook and inflation trajectory, as well as the Federal Reserve's monetary policy, they add. The U.S. dollar is 0.1% higher at 1.2901 Singapore dollars, LSEG data show. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
